high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from Wikipedia, specifically the article about Vera Wang. The content discusses Vera Wang's career and business ventures. The text mentions that in 1990, Vera Wang opened her first design salon at the Carlyle Hotel in New York City, featuring her trademark bridal gowns. She has since expanded her brand by opening bridal boutiques in New York, London, Tokyo, and Sydney, and has diversified her offerings through fragrances, jewelry, eyewear, shoes, and homeware collections. The text also notes the launch of "White by Vera Wang" on February 11, 2
